versions.announcement: Update 6.7 is now available!! Legendary Mode, Revamped Elite 4 rematches, PC Boxes improvements, French Translation, and more!

categories.name: New Game mode and french translation
changes: Added "Legendary mode" game mode unlockable with new game+
Every trainer Pokemon is fused with a legendary
Added built-in french translation (Thanks @Anthony 📛, @Frog's dusty basement door, @Willi)
Added "mixed generations" as a custom starter option

categories.name: Elite Four rematches
changes: Reworked the Elite 4 rooms, including a completely remade champion room (Thanks @Kiwi)
Added a new Pokémon league rematch system with multiple difficulty tiers
Trainer AI now uses healing items more intelligently

categories.name: PC boxes improvements
changes: Added multi-select mode in PC boxes enabled by pressing Shift (Adapted from KurayMod - Thanks @Sylvi)
Selected Pokémon can be sorted with various criteria
Improved fusing from the PC

categories.name: Quality of life gameplay improvements
changes: Added option to relearn moves directly from the party screen
Made it possible to throw Pokéballs when battling more than 1 Pokémon

categories.name: Cosmetic stuff
changes: Added Wallpaper Lottery to unlock new PC Wallpapers
Made it possible to flip hats placed on Pokémon horizontally and vertically

categories.name: Bug Fixes
changes: Various bugfixes (thanks @FauxBlue)

versions.announcement: Shinies now finally have their official colors, along with a bunch of other cool stuff!

categories.name: Gameplay
changes: Improved shinies (massive thanks to @Anthony 📛)
Shiny Pokémon now use their official shiny colors
Shiny colors are now given through full palette swaps instead of simple hue shifts
Pokémon icons now appear shiny in the PC and party screen
Quest NPCs and NPCs offering trades now appear with a marker over their head
Added an option to Fuse/Unfuse Pokémon directly from the party screen
Added Flying and Dark type experts
Added a game option to allow alt sprites to be randomly selected when encountering new Pokemon
Clothes shop menus now use different colors to identify city exclusive outfits and regional outfits
Added more character customization options
Added more custom Pokédex entries

categories.name: Graphics and menus
changes: Overworld flowers and beach shores are now animated
Added new loading screen images
Long spriter credits can now be displayed on multiple lines (thanks @FauxBlue)
Battle menu cursor now automatically goes back to "Fight" option after switching Pokémon

versions.announcement: Double hats, new looks for gym leaders, and a bunch of bug fixes.

categories.name: Character customization
changes: Added 24 new hats, 11 new clothes and 9 new hairstyle options
Made it possible to wear two hats at once
Added new hairstyles in the Saffron City boutique
Added Dye Kit items; Dyeing clothes and hats is now done through the outfits menu once you have the items

categories.name: Gameplay
changes: Added an item to set favorite outfits and quickly switch to them
Changed the Meloetta obtained at the end of the "Legendary Band" questline into a Meloetta (A) / Meloetta (P) fusion
Spriter NPCs that sometimes appear in the Art Gallery now all have a unique randomized appearance
Updated the overworld and battle sprites for several gym leaders and NPCs
Fusions now play the cry from both base Pokémon

categories.name: System
changes: Added an option for toggling Custom Egg sprites
Changed the game's loading screen
The game now prompts players to download new spritepacks when they are released
Fight option is now automatically selected after switching a Pokémon in battles

versions.announcement: 30 new Pokémon, full trainer customization, and a ton of new side content.

categories.name: Pokémon
changes: Added 31 new Pokémon (including form changes)
Added a triple fusion of the Kalos starters
Updated Remix mode teams (Thanks funkytomate)

categories.name: Character customization
changes: Added various hats, clothes, hairstyles that the player can wear
129 hats, 79 clothes, 66 hairstyles (4 base colors each)
Added the ability to put hats on Pokémon
Added customizable trainer cards

categories.name: Quests / Game events
changes: Added the ability to join Team Rocket, along with several Team Rocket sidequests
Added Pinkan Island heist event
Added new quests to obtain some of the new Pokémon
Added special "type expert" npc battles scattered throughout Kanto

categories.name: UI
changes: Updated the game's intro screen graphics (thanks doctormiawoo)
Increased fast text speed option's speed
Clicking empty spots in the town map now snaps the cursor to the nearest Fly spot
Added a prompt for registering registerable key items when obtaining them
Added option for displaying the opponent's Pokémon type in battles

categories.name: System
changes: Sprites are now loaded from spritesheets instead of individual sprites
Saving the game now creates backup savefiles
Various bugfixes
